ticks.note: Tick 1: no train, the barrier is up (`isUp`), the crossing is `Open`.
A train enters the track circuit: `occupied`. The crossing starts its warning time.
Three: the warning time is over, `lower` starts the barrier motor.
The barrier leaves its upper limit switch.
It reaches the lower one: `isDown`. The crossing is `Closed`.
The track circuit is clear: the barrier is raised (`lower` false).
The barrier leaves the lower limit switch.
